title: An assistant that shows you where things are
description: Ask the assistant in the bottom-right corner where something is, in your own words. It flies to the sidebar, opens the page, points at each control with a short explanation, then flies back to its corner.
items: Understands everyday wording and Taglish, like "file a leave", "nakalimutan mag time out" or "sahod", and small typos
Filing a leave, overtime, a missed punch or a reimbursement ends with that request form already open
"Guide me through this page" walks through the page you are on, field by field, including a new client form
On Tasks it covers the views, filters, every icon on a task row, then opens New task and explains each field
Only offers pages your role can open, and says so when something is out of reach
Skip, Next or Esc stop a tour at any time; with reduced motion turned on it does not animate
